content.stem: 正如巴塞尔委员会关于"有效管理洗钱和恐怖融资相关风险"的指导所强调的,第三道防线,即审计职能应当:

options.A: 为保持年度报告的一致性,反洗钱审计的频率不得低于每12个月一次.
options.B: 不对有关补救措施或行动计划是否足以解决发现的问题和提出的建议发表意见.
options.C: 参与反洗钱计划的日常运作,以立即防止控制失效.
options.D: 向董事会审计委员会报告以保持独立性.

content.stem_en: As emphasized in the Basel Committee guidance for Sound management of risks related to money laundering and financing of terrorism, the third line of defense, or audit function, should:

options_en.A: Conduct AML audits no less often than every 12 months for consistency in annual reporting
options_en.B: Remain independent from expressing opinions on the sufficiency of remediation or action plans to address findings and recommendations
options_en.C: Be involved in the day-to-day operations of the AML program to immediately prevent control failures
options_en.D: Report to the audit committee of the board to maintain independence
